notes: «فلقيت مالكا قلت كيف كان ابن مسعود يقول»: Malik is asked and answers, so he is a link; Ibn Masʿud's words follow, so he is the last link (rule 6)

NEEDS RULING: «ذكرت عن عبد الله بن عتبة بن مسعود» and «قال ابن أبي ليلى» are inside the story (Ibn Abi Layla is only present; Ibn Utba is cited as the source of the opinion); not put in the chain, because the text does not say whether his words are relayed as the saying
«- للأنصار -» is a gloss and is left out
